selector_config.anchor: first 1 sentence(s), applied to B/C/D alike
selector_config.scorer: Okapi BM25, k1=1.5 b=0.75, IDF over this document's chunks

oracle_availability.note: Oracle is excluded for unanswerable rows by construction: a question with no determined answer has no supporting evidence to select. Rows are also excluded when a supporting fact fails to localise, rather than being approximated.

query_vs_oracle_overlap.note: Low overlap means D selects different chunks from B. Whether D is an upper bound is measured in the eval stage, not assumed here.

suite.note: Held-out dev split of the Phase 1 curriculum, disjoint from its train split and from the demo suite. Longer contexts and 2688/2688 verbatim supporting_facts, so D is localised exactly. No published baseline exists for this split, so it carries no validity gate.
